findings.defect: The Inventory storage command is omitted, obscuring the first half of the store-and-resummon maneuver.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly has Taekyung store White Flame in his Inventory before opening it and summoning the weapon back into his hand.

findings.current: He asked me to call him Aquaman.
findings.defect: The translation silently corrects the deliberately malformed or misremembered name 아구아맨 to Aquaman, removing the joke in Cheongpung’s recollection.
findings.rationale: The source says 아구아맨 rather than the standard Korean rendering 아쿠아맨, and the surrounding hesitation foregrounds Cheongpung’s imperfect recollection.
findings.replacement: He asked me to call him Aguaman.

findings.current: The sudden jolt to its body made the sphere of water, which had been nearing completion, falter. But the satisfaction on my face hardened at once.
findings.defect: The source says Taekyung’s expression hardened despite accomplishing his immediate objective; it does not describe satisfaction hardening on his face.
findings.rationale: 소기의 목적을 달성한 means that he achieved his intended purpose, while 얼굴은 딱딱하게 굳었다 describes his expression turning rigid.
findings.replacement: The sudden jolt to its body made the sphere of water, which had been nearing completion, falter. But despite accomplishing what I’d intended, my expression hardened.
findings.source: 갑작스럽게 동체가 흔들리자 빠르게 완성되어 가던 물의 구가 주춤했지만, 소기의 목적을 달성한 내 얼굴은 딱딱하게 굳었다.

findings.current: “There’s something I want to ask. Did you happen to learn water arts while I wasn’t looking?”
findings.defect: 몇 가지 is plural, and 못 본 사이 means during the time they had not seen each other, not while Mungyeong literally was not looking.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves both the plural setup and the interval between their meetings.
findings.replacement: “There are a few things I want to ask. Did you happen to learn water arts since we last saw each other?”
findings.source: “몇 가지 묻고 싶은 게 있는데. 혹시 못 본 사이에 수공(水功)이라도 익혔나?”

findings.current: “You really are arbitrary. It sounds like you’re saying you never learned water arts after all.”
findings.defect: “You really are arbitrary” is an unnatural dictionary gloss and does not convey Mungyeong’s criticism that Jeok Cheongang simply does whatever he pleases.
findings.rationale: 제멋대로 describes self-willed behavior, and the replacement preserves Mungyeong’s dry, blunt register.
findings.replacement: “You really do whatever you please. It sounds like you never learned water arts after all.”
findings.source: “정말이지 제멋대로군. 결국 수공을 익히지 않았다는 이야기로 들리는데.”

findings.defect: The command is redundant and unnatural in English.
findings.rationale: The source gives a direct command to assume an attack formation; the replacement conveys it without repeating “formation” and “form.”

summary: Two meaningful fidelity defects and four localized wording issues.
